items.stem:
Read the passage below, based on the story 'How I Taught My Grandmother to Read', and answer.

"Every Wednesday the postman brought the thick weekly magazine, and every Wednesday evening Ajji settled on her mat with her betel box beside her. 'Read,' she would say, and I would read the new chapter aloud while she listened without moving, sometimes smiling, sometimes wiping her eyes with the end of her sari."

Who read the new chapter, and to whom?
items.answer: The narrator read it aloud to Ajji (her grandmother).

items.stem:
Read the passage below, based on the story 'How I Taught My Grandmother to Read', and answer.

"She traced the letters on her slate again and again until the chalk wore down to a stub. When she made a mistake, she did not sigh; she only wiped the slate with her palm and began once more. 'A child of six can do this,' she said, 'so why not a woman of sixty?'"

Answer the following:
(i) What did the woman write on?  (a) A slate  (b) A wall  (c) A computer  (d) A notebook
(ii) What did she do when she made a mistake?
(iii) Which quality does the woman show?  (a) Fear  (b) Laziness  (c) Determination/perseverance  (d) Pride
(iv) What does her question "so why not a woman of sixty?" mean?
items.answer: (i) (a) A slate (ii) She wiped the slate with her palm and began once more. (iii) (c) Determination/perseverance (iv) If a small child can learn to write, age should not stop her from learning too.
items.markingKey: (i) (a) A slate (ii) She wiped the slate with her palm and began once more. (iii) (c) Determination/perseverance (iv) If a small child can learn to write, age should not stop her from learning too. (1 mark each, 4 marks.)

items.stem:
Read the survey report and answer the questions that follow.

A survey on music in daily life was carried out in Patna in 2026. 1000 students were asked when they listen to music most. The results were: while studying – 46%; while travelling – 26%; while exercising – 4%; before sleeping – 7%; rarely or never – 17%. The word "soothing" came up often in the discussion that followed the survey.

(i) Which response was the most common?  (a) rarely or never  (b) before sleeping  (c) while studying  (d) while travelling
(ii) By how many percentage points does "before sleeping" differ from "rarely or never"?  (a) 7  (b) 24  (c) 10  (d) 15
(iii) What percentage of students chose one of the two most common responses taken together?  (a) 72%  (b) 28%  (c) 46%  (d) 82%
(iv) In the passage, the word "soothing" means …  (a) the pleasure of being with others  (b) communication by letters or messages  (c) calming  (d) free time
(v) What fraction of the students did NOT choose "before sleeping"? Answer as a percentage.  (a) 43%  (b) 7%  (c) 83%  (d) 93%
items.answer: (i) (c) while studying (ii) (c) 10 (iii) (a) 72% (iv) (c) calming (v) (d) 93%
items.markingKey: (i) (c) while studying (ii) (c) 10 (iii) (a) 72% (iv) (c) calming (v) (d) 93% (1 mark each.)
